policies.nodeDefinition: one root plus every attempted core search simulation, including rejected probes; replay costs time but no search nodes
policies.depthDefinition: explicit command layers; derived automatic passes belong to their command

commands: node --test --test-reporter=spec tests/ai.test.mjs tests/ai-matrix.test.mjs tests/ai-tactics.test.mjs tests/session.test.mjs tests/restore-session.test.mjs tests/web.test.mjs

coveredBoundaries: consecutive A turns during opening and consecutive B turns after choosing white
alpha-beta cutoffs compared with an independent exhaustive mixed-turn oracle
immediate win, direct defense, three-command winning fork and far capture of a pending five
one-node no-action failure; two-node legal fallback; no node-budget overrun
explicit depth caps and incomplete-iteration preservation
deadline and cancellation during replay and search
latched cancellation when the deadline is also reached while finishing
illegal PSK recaptures consume allowance and never become fallback actions
fixed-five clocks, pressure inheritance, pass confirmation, legal draw and automatic passes
same request and deterministic clock reproducibility
actual monotonic-clock cutoff and default easy/standard profiles on 9 and 19 boards
real reply commit-once and stale-after-pause/new-game guards

complexExample.result: standard reaches a core-confirmed black win after three explicit commands; easy depth two has not reached the terminal result

limits: Deeper search is selective: critical moves are preserved and ordinary candidates are limited by policy.
Completed depth describes the selected tree with legitimate alpha-beta pruning, not exhaustive whole-board play.
Time is checked between atomic operations. One indivisible core or feature computation can overshoot the deadline.
The current synchronous function is not a UI-thread responsiveness or Worker hard-termination guarantee.
The matrix uses deterministic small node budgets; it is not 1792 full games or a strength/fairness evaluation.
The earlier P5.2 full decision matrix is historical evidence; this round reran its 26 tactical tests, not that separate full matrix.
No browser human-vs-AI or actual Windows runtime verification in this stage.
